definitions: A tool with a long handle and a row of teeth at the head, used for gathering leaves, hay, or debris, or for smoothing soil.
A dissolute man, especially one who is habitually immoral or lecherous.
The angle at which a part or component is set in relation to the horizontal or vertical.
A garden tool consisting of a row of tines attached to a long handle, used for gathering leaves, hay, or debris, or for levelling soil.
examples: He used a rake to clear the leaves from the lawn.
The old rake spent his evenings at the gambling hall.
The rake of the stage gave the audience a better view.
She bought a new rake for her gardening.
